tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bye tshogs chos skyong la phul ba// kyai/ snyigs dus rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bsgos ltar/ /shugs drag las ldan rtsal gyi mtshan 'chang ba/ /rta mgrin dbang dang pad+ma ka ra'i zhabs/ /dī paṃ ka ra 'jam dpal snying po dang / /sa skya'i rje btsun de slob rmor chen rje/ /rig 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' dam ltar/ /rnam bzhi'i las kyis bstan 'gro spyi bye la/ /bsrung skyob thugs dam gnyen po ma g.yel zhig /bdag nyid 'khon rigs 'dzin pa 'khor bcas la/ /'phral yun nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i spang gnyen sogs/ /'khrul med lung gis drang thig 'debs pa dang / /gang bcol phrin las mdzod cig sa ma ya/ /zhes 'di 'khon ston kun blo yis/ /kun ldan lo yi gro bzhin gyi/ /tshes gsum sku gsol thog tu dge /bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ ༈ /bye tshogs sku rten kun dga' ye shes la sku phebs skabs phul/ kye/ rdo rje'i tha tshig gson cig rgyal po che/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs rig 'dzin 'dus sde kun/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan sogs spel ba yi/ /rdo rje'i srung mar khyod nyid ma byon nam/ /shugs drag ldan pa'i thugs dam ma g.yel bar/ /shugs drag ldan pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs dbus/ /shugs drag ldan pa'i bskul tshig rol rnga'i sgras/ /shugs drag ldan khyod 'bod do da lta byon/ /rtsal gyi mtshan 'chang dam can dregs byed gtso/ /stsal ba'i dgos don bstan 'gro'i legs nyes la/ /stsal 'os lung de gzugs can lus rten thog /stsal ran g.yar dam gnyen po ma g.yel zhig /dad dang dam tshig ldan spyi khyad par du/ /lha khyod gnas pa'i gzhal yas 'di nyid du/ /phyi nang gsang rten dngos 'byor yid sprul bshams/ /rgyun du bstan sgrub da dgongs gshegs su gsol/ /dregs byed la gus 'on kyang bag med kun/ /snying nas 'gyod bshags gdung bas 'bod lags na/ /brtse drag thugs dam drag gzhan ma g.yel bar/ /da lta nyid du lus rten 'dir byin phob/

/bskul yang mi gsan bshags kyang mi dag na/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa yal ta re/ /khyod kyis thugs dam drag shugs bor ta re/ /yus pa'i tshig 'di dgongs la da lta byon/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las spyi dang bye brag tu/ /drag po'i las kyis bstan 'gror phan 'dogs pa'i/ /lhan skyes dregs byed dam tshig 'gyur ba med/ /tshul 'di dgongs la dam ldan las mdzod cig /ces gdung dbyangs rnga rol dud sprin khrag chang 'thor zhing rkang gling dar g.yab pa bcas spyan drang ngo / /zhes 'di bye tshogs kun ye la/ /chos skyong sku khog 'os shar du/ /phebs kar sa skya kun blo yis/ /gnad bskul zhus so 'grub gyur cig ༈ /shing bya can la/ oṃ swasti/ nga rgyal rnam dag tshor phung gnas gyur yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan nyid/ dmu rgod 'dul phyir gdul bya'i dbang gis dregs pa'i skur bzhengs pa rgyal po shing bya can nyid bstan 'gror phan phyir gzugs can khog brlam dgos par bla ma gong mas bka' bsgos shing / nyid kyis zhal bzhes dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod la sku rten sa phag lo pa 'dir zhal gzigs nas spyi sger blang dor gsal bar lung bstan pa'i dus la babs pas de bzhin du mdzod cig rten lha gos bcas sa skya pa kun blos dge/ ༈ /dwags grwar bse khrab can la/ kye/ bse yi khrab can rno ba'i ngar dang ldan/ /rngog lo che sogs skyes chen du ma'i gnas/ /bsrung zhing skyong la snyigs dus ches cher dpa'/ /deng 'dir bkra shis bskor bar phebs thog 'dir/ /'phrin rten gos dar ras sna lpags rigs mtshon/ /go cha phrin las myur mgyogs rta mchog mdog /rtag par grags la sga chas ldan pa dang / /yon tan rten du 'bras gro nas dkar 'dren/ /rin chen snod du phyur por bkang ba dang / /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dar snas spras/ /gsung rten rol mo'i nga ros dbang drag ster/ /sku rten gu ru pad+ma gang 'dul sku/

/phyi mchod chu gnyis nyer spyod snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /nang mchod sman raka gtor ma dam tshig rdzas/ /drag po'i nyer spyod gsang mchod rdo rje dril/ /dngos 'byor 'di dang yid sprul kun bzang 'phrul/ /dmar nag mi khrom dpal g.yang 'dzoms khyim du/ /chos skyong che nyid lus g.yar la brten pa/ /khri 'ur 'khyil bzhugs dgon 'dir dge zhal phyogs/ /gzi brjid nyams ldan de thog dngos rnams nas/ /lhag bsam dag pas 'bul lo snod bcud 'di'i/ /'gal rkyen srungs shig mthun rkyen chos srid spel/ /thun mong mchog kun gang bsam myur du mdzod// ༈ /drag zhu chos skyong la phul ba/ kyai/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mnga' gzhug zhing bcu'i gshegs/ /shugs ldan drag rtsal las la thogs med pa'i/ /bstan srung gang nas brtse drags blang dor lung / /ji bzhin stsal ba'i don bzhin bsgrubs pa dang / /bsgrub 'gyur legs gso brten sgrub rnal 'byor nga'i/ /tshe yi bar chad lus kyi na tsha dang / /sems kyi sdug bsngal byur dang skal ba ngan/ /bkra mi shis dang lo zla zhag skeg dang / /sri ngan chag che nyam nga'i rigs kun las/ /myur du rgyal bar mdzod cig rgyal po che/ /rta mgrin dbang gi mtshon don dbu chings dmar/ /rjes chags bde chen 'bar ba'i khrab gdan mdog /phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i cod paṇa rgyan/ /glog ltar myur ba mtshon byed rgod thul can/ /gdug pa tshar gcod rno ngar ral gri 'bar/ /rta mchog rlung shugs yid la bsam dgu ster/ /rga srab mdzes chas ldan sogs dngos 'byor dang / /yid sprul mthun rdzas 'di bzhes spyi bye'i bstan/ /rgyas shing bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /'jig rten bde dang bdag gi rnam bzhi'i las/ /gang bcol mdzod cig srung ma dam tshig can/ /'khon ston chen po puṇ+ya rat+na dang / /rmor chen rje sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka'/ /dran par mdzod la bdag gis gsol mchod 'bras/

/'phral yun gang la ci dgos myur 'grub pa'i/ /mtshan ma mngon sum ston cig dregs byed gtso/ /zhes 'di dbang bsdud snying po la/ /chos skyong 'di 'go'i mthun rdzas rnams/ /bstar dus sa rgan kun blo yis/ /gong dkar rtse nas dge bar gtam// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bye tshogs chos skyong la phul ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
